What this demo demonstrates — and its limits

This is a 2.5D photo-billboard experiment using development sequence KITTI 0012. The car is a scaled photograph on a fixed backdrop. It is not a photorealistic 3D driving simulator. Perspective, lighting, vehicle orientation, occlusion and background motion are simplified.

The measured detector, five-model distance ensemble, confidence thresholds and Kalman settings are loaded unchanged. Their estimates can be biased or missing on rendered images. The controller uses an illustrative stopping-distance rule with 6 m/s² nominal braking; it is not trained or validated for driving. Optical-axis TTC does not guarantee a collision. The late-obstacle scenario retains a possible collision.

Simulation advances in 0.1 s steps. Inference wall time is shown separately; this UI does not benchmark the published T4 latency. One server shares one episode across browser tabs. KITTI imagery: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Code: AGPL-3.0.
